name: PlainShelter: Build a Shelter
subtitle: Build a shelter, step by step
shortDescription: Tell PlainShelter what you have and where you are. It shows the fastest safe shelter, then walks you through it. Works offline, every step cited.
longDescription:
Build a shelter from what is around you.

Pick where you are (forest, snow, desert, marsh or coast) and tick what you have: a tarp, rope, branches, a shovel, snow. PlainShelter ranks the shelters you can actually build, fastest first, then walks you through one in numbered steps with a diagram and a citation on every step.

### Survive First, Then Make It Better
- 11 survival shelters, free: tarp lean-to, tarp tent, debris hut, snow cave, snow trench, tree-pit and fallen-tree snow shelters, swamp bed, beach and desert shade, and a pole lean-to.
- Guided build: what to gather, then one step per screen. Read-aloud if you want it, and the screen stays awake. Resume where you left off.
- Knots and lashings for frames, free.
- Supporting guides, free: staying warm and dry, fire, and safe weather practices around your shelter.
- The upgrade ladder (Pro): secure it against weather, make it comfortable and warm, ventilate and use fire safely, and build something that lasts: durable frames, walls, roofs and drainage, doors and air.

### Shelters of the World
- 298 guides to how people build on every continent and in every climate: tents, earth, adobe and rammed earth, timber and log, masonry, brick, concrete and lime, thatch and bamboo, snow and Arctic buildings, tropical and desert houses, and earthquake, flood and storm-resilient construction. Filter by climate, material, kind and region.
- Practical construction: site and foundations, floors, walls, roofs, chimneys, doors and windows, drainage and moisture, with numbered steps and a citation on every one.

### What You Can Do
- Plan for your climate: pick your climate, how long you need the shelter and what you have; the planner ranks every guide, from build-now to worth-planning-for.
- Find the right shelter: pick where you are and what you have, and the app ranks what you can really build.
- Build step by step: guided mode with a gather checklist, numbered cited steps, diagrams, read-aloud and resume.
- Check your site: an interactive safety checklist for the spot you chose.
- Climb the ladder: mark upgrades done, see your progress from survive to thrive, and get your next step suggested.
- Practise scenarios: get a situation, choose the shelter you would build, and learn why.
- Search every guide offline; save guides, share the steps as text, and keep your own notes.

### Every Recommendation Is Cited
- Guidance comes from public-domain and open sources. Tap a citation to read the bundled excerpt, or open the original in the app and use Back to return to where you were.
- Everything works offline. No signal needed.

### Private and Clear
PlainShelter is general information from public-domain and open sources. It is not professional, medical or emergency-service advice. In danger, call your local emergency number first. Never burn fire or fuel in a closed shelter.

PlainShelter is built by one highly experienced engineer, amplified by the world's most advanced AI agents.
monetization: Free, no ads, optional monthly subscription
